scope: Audit resource prefilter against actual allocation granularity. No solver source/candidate change, CUDA kernel launch, historical candidate rescue or speed claim.
basis: User requests >=1% complete-cycle gain without material tradeoffs. A nominal register increase may fit the same rounded warp allocation. CUDA12.9.79 occupancy header explicitly handles compute12.x and computes rounded allocatedRegistersPerBlock. Validate its model against all60 retained driver occupancy observations and every1..1024thread count at all10geometries.

references.use: NVIDIA distinguishes nominal registers from rounded allocation and occupancy; allocation granularity varies by compute capability.

references.allocation_formula: cudaOccMaxBlocksPerMultiprocessorRegsLimit rounds nominal registers*warpSize to the per-warp allocation granularity, then multiplies by ceil(threads/warpSize).
